settings.question: Is this one device for both knees?
settings.answer: Yes. The housing has two separate knee openings with a central divider.

settings.question: How large is the device?
settings.answer: The overall dimensions are 360 × 242 × 160 mm. Overall dimensions do not specify the internal fitting range.

settings.heading: Built into your evening.
settings.text: On the tools. On your feet. Down at floor level. Skilled work asks a lot of you. Your time at home deserves consideration, too.

settings.question: Is Kneora a fabric knee wrap?
settings.answer: No. Kneora is a rigid dual-knee unit with a white shell and separate knee openings.

settings.question: Where can I find use and care instructions?
settings.answer: Follow the instructions provided with your device. Contact the store if you need help finding your product documentation.
